probes.scope: engine terminal result and adapter perspective; do not feed a missing-king board into the leaf model

probes.expected: queen attack/danger columns match the engine golden vectors; colour twins have identical probabilities
probes.scope: matched legal turn alternatives require additional owner-reviewed raw evidence; cross-position probability order is not a theorem

jvm_golden_parity.inputs: Every authored, non-sample golden probe at the pinned enrichment engine version.
jvm_golden_parity.comparison: Candidate ONNX Runtime probability versus JVM position response from the same side-to-move perspective.

torch_onnx_parity.inputs: Every authored golden vector plus all qualification rows; retain raw observations privately.
torch_onnx_parity.comparison: The manifest-bound training model in inference mode versus the exact exported ONNX bytes; use identical float32 features and embedded preprocessing/calibration.

probability_bounds.inputs: All golden, qualification and concurrency-workload inference outputs.
probability_bounds.acceptance: Every raw model output is finite and within the closed interval [0,1] before any serving clamp; no missing, extra or reordered rows; tensor shapes match the declared contract.

concurrency.workload_binding: The same concurrency_workload_sha256 must appear in the preregistered seal and serving evidence. The private workload manifest freezes concurrency levels, duration, request mix/order, engine/runtime identity, warmup and sample accounting before results.
concurrency.acceptance: Every admitted request completes without timeout, crash, cross-request state contamination or incorrect row/candidate mapping; all outputs satisfy probability bounds and match serial replay within the JVM parity tolerance. Saturated requests follow the existing documented admission response. Aggregate latency_p95_ms and rss_mb stay within sealed serving_limits; retain raw counts, errors and measurements.

immediate_king_capture.acceptance: The specified legal played turn returns mover probability 1 and performs no model call for that terminal candidate.

forced_loss.acceptance: After the specified capture the engine winner is White and loser is Black; the captured side has terminal outcome 0. Do not reinterpret a nonterminal threat as certain loss.

piece_safety.acceptance: Queen attack/danger vectors match the pinned engine golden corpus and colour twins preserve the same mover probability within the JVM parity tolerance. The private raw evidence also records owner-reviewed matched legal turn alternatives; probability ordering across unmatched boards is not an acceptance criterion.
